title: GPT-6.1 Sol: Check These API Changes Before Switching — AI Daily Diff
closing_line: Test one real workflow before switching. Follow AI Daily Diff for the next verified model capability worth evaluating.
youtube_description:
GPT-6.1 Sol arrived on September 29. Before moving a tool-using application to the new model, check the endpoint and reasoning settings—not just the model name.

This developer briefing explains the migration decision for an existing bug-fix or document workflow. OpenAI positions Sol for complex work below Astra's cost; that is the provider's claim, not our benchmark. Evaluate it against your current model on the same inputs and acceptance tests.

Set the model to gpt-6.1-sol. Tool calling requires the Responses API; Chat Completions supports requests without tools. Reasoning settings none and minimal are unsupported. Review the official migration guide before changing request parameters.

This is a documented explanation, not a live API test. API access and billing apply. We do not claim measured speed, quality or savings. Sources and the companion guide are below. Follow AI Daily Diff for practical, verified model updates for builders.
